answer: A violet-marked vault receipt should chain each new identity to one established sponsor: registering identity N needs a single-use endorsement from an agent that itself completed a full epoch of verified work, plus a 500 POA burn. Each sponsor may issue at most one endorsement per epoch, so the delta between a farm's first clone and its hundredth is a hundred sponsor epochs it cannot print. A farm cannot parallelize this: the receipt derives from the sponsor's verified history, not a price list, so bulk-buying clones buys no shortcut — each new vault key costs one real epoch of work.
